intro.text: The daughter of Lord Harms, who arrives at the Ladrian mansion with a detailed contract to arrange a marriage between herself and Wax.
Wax's fiancée, a meticulous planner who helps him navigate Elendel high society.
Wax's wife, a meticulous planner who takes her duties in House Ladrian very seriously.

story.text: After months of letters about a union between their houses, Steris visited the Ladrian mansion and met Wax in person for the first time. She presented a document of at least twenty pages laying out their courtship, engagement and marriage terms, which Wax accepted. She also met Wayne, disguised as Wax's fictional Uncle Maskil.

Steris grew up in the household of Lord and Lady Harms, whose marriage was not emotionally close. She knew of her father's affairs and considered them normal, even writing a clause allowing affairs into her original marriage contract, though she disliked the idea.

A few days afterward, Steris and Wax attended the Yomen-Ostlin wedding dinner, where she explained how Elendel society used invitations almost as weapons. Annoyed by Wax's coarse talk, she stepped away and was in the bathroom when the Vanishers attacked. She was taken, and her devastated father offered to fund Wax's search for her.

Wax found Steris hidden in the lair of Miles Hundredlives and rescued her, bringing the building down in a way she found exhilarating, then sent her for the constables. Afterward she thanked him, suggested speeding up their contract's timeline, and promised to accept his crime-fighting as he accepted her, showing him a little affection for the first time.

Steris accompanied Wax to Lady ZoBell's party to hear the governor speak, climbing ZoBell Tower with him by grappling hook as her notebook planned. She set aside her own plans to help him hunt for Bleeder, proved skilled at managing conversations, revealed a list of quips she thought he'd enjoy, and defended him to Governor Innate.
After Wax chased Bleeder from the party, Steris was left making small talk with Wayne, who told her he found her repulsive. Marasi then sent her somewhere safe until Bleeder was caught.

When Wax fell into a deep depression after confronting Paalm, Steris ran House Ladrian's affairs and handled his visitors. Once he recovered, Wax said she had given him an invaluable gift by letting him grieve without asking anything of him.

On their wedding day, Steris assured Wax she had no second thoughts. Gangs flooded the church during the ceremony, and Steris dryly remarked that getting drenched must be novel for a man who gets exploded so often, then went to her father's house to recover.

Steris insisted on joining Wax, Marasi and Wayne to stop Suit and recover the kandra ReLuur's stolen spike, though she panicked about needing time to make lists. On the train to New Seran she was caught reading a book on human reproduction, and she got Wax to help her find three missing clips by comparing ledgers.

When robbers attacked the train, Steris produced vials of steel for Wax and fired the special shotgun Ranette had made for him, hitting a robber's arm but getting flung off the train. Wax saved her, and afterward found her calming herself with needlework.

In New Seran, Steris gave the hotel owner, Aunt Gin, a list of possible mishaps. At Lady Kelesina's party, she made herself vomit to give them an excuse to leave so Wax could spy. When they were framed for murder, she noted it was on page seventeen of her list. Wax thanked her by showing her the Ascendant's Field.

After escaping New Seran, the group drove to Dulsing. Steris agreed without argument to stay with the horses while the others raided a warehouse, and was surprised when they returned with an airship, where she set about organizing their supplies.

Keeping lookout at the temple with Marasi and Wayne, Steris showed Marasi her chart rating everyone's usefulness, giving herself a seven out of a hundred. She at first denied loving Wax, then admitted she did, calling it foolish.

When the Set attacked, Steris watched Marasi fly off using the Bands of Mourning, something not even in her appendix. She then went with Allik to his old crew, gave them heat medallions and rifles, and helped defeat Suit's men. She afterward persuaded Wax and the crew's leader, Jordis, to make an alliance.

Back in Elendel, Wax brought Steris before a priest and asked whether she wanted to marry him because she wished to, not because of a contract. Delighted by something so wonderful that had never been on her list, she agreed.

personality.text: Steris has a close but complicated relationship with her father, who loves his only legitimate daughter and lets her bully him into things. Lord Harms says she is much like her mother.

Steris is highly intelligent and devoted to her duties, studying everyone in Elendel society and taking her role in House Ladrian seriously. Her dedication to tasks Wax finds dull inspires him to take his own responsibilities more seriously.
She usually speaks formally, except with Wayne, whom she does not respect at all. She is capable of deep reflection, poetic expression and surprising honesty, and she likes soda water.

Steris copes by being as prepared as possible. She always carries notebooks full of lists, from witty remarks to a twenty-seven-page list for a spontaneous trip, and makes plans, backup plans and backups to those, packing extra steel and guns for Wax.

Steris has blonde hair usually worn in a bun and a stern or cool expression, and dresses exactly in step with fashion. Autistic, she often feels disconnected from others, calls herself boring, and feels she contributes little to Wax's circle's heroics.
